name: Shenzhen Megmeet Electrical Co., LTD
summary: Shenzhen Megmeet Electrical Co., LTD operates as an electrical automation company in China. The company offers power solutions, including datacenter, enclosed, display, telecom, high-voltage microwave, and electric and laser power supply solutions; industrial automation products comprising AC drive, servo and control systems, industry-specific products, encoder, internal gear pumps, and Mlink IoT; eMobility and EV infrastructure products, such as electric vehicle, charging point, railway transport, and light electric vehicle products, as well as electric scroll compressors and construction equipment.
